```yaml
name: Update Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-meeting-minutes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go install github.com/golang/dep/cmd/dep@latest
          go mod tidy

      - name: Fetch latest meeting from Discourse
        id: fetch_meeting
        run: |
          # Get the latest post from the community category
          LATEST_POST=$(curl -s "https://discuss.layer5.io/c/community/6.json" | jq -r '.latest_posts[0].id')
          if [ -z "$LATEST_POST" ] || [ "$LATEST_POST" = "null" ]; then
            echo "No posts found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Get the content of the latest post
          POST_CONTENT=$(curl -s "https://discuss.layer5.io/posts/$LATEST_POST.json" | jq -r '.raw')
          if [ -z "$POST_CONTENT" ] || [ "$POST_CONTENT" = "null" ]; then
            echo "Failed to get post content"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Extract title and date
          TITLE=$(curl -s "https://discuss.layer5.io/posts/$LATEST_POST.json" | jq -r '.topic_title')
          DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d")
          
          # Sanitize title for filename
          SANITIZED_TITLE=$(echo "$TITLE" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/_/g' | cut -c1-50)
          FILENAME="${DATE}_${SANITIZED_TITLE}.md"
          
          # Create archive directory if it doesn't exist
          mkdir -p .github/meetings/archive
          
          # Write content to file
          echo "# $TITLE" > ".github/meetings/archive/$FILENAME"
          echo "" >> ".github/meetings/archive/$FILENAME"
          echo "$POST_CONTENT" >> ".github/meetings/archive/$FILENAME"
          
          echo "filename=$FILENAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "title=$TITLE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.fetch_meeting.outputs.filename != ''
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .github/meetings/archive/
          git commit -m "Update meeting minutes: ${{ steps.fetch_meeting.outputs.title }}" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }} || echo "No changes to push"

      - name: Notify on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Failed to update meeting minutes"
          exit 1
```
